title: Native Switchyard Deck Projection
objective: Remove the old hardcoded Command Deck model-selection duplicate and project the resident native Switchyard through the existing Panda-clear Models surface using one canonical candidate roster.

great_harvest_preflight.reason: The UI seam already exists but duplicates selection logic. Preserve its operator clarity while replacing the duplicate backend with the native resident resolver.

pandaos_reconstruction.rule: Keep the simple Panda-style model-choice explanation, but all decisions come from native OTHRYS Switchyard and canonical project policy.

laws: Command Deck may project Switchyard evidence but may not implement a second selector.
Candidate facts live in one canonical project model policy; UI code does not invent provider health or certification.
Unknown measured trust remains explicit and cannot be fabricated for ranking.
Paid or unavailable remote escalation remains non-executing and approval-gated.
Presentation never grants execution or approval authority.
